acceptanceCriteria: A1: Required unverified scenarios with expectedResult and verificationPlan are implementation-ready but not verified
A2: Human preflight decision evidence binds repository Work Item Contract and preflight identity
A3: Missing malformed stale or foreign decision evidence fails closed and cannot authorize checkpoint
A4: Planned implementation never authorizes finish archive close or release without executed scenario evidence
A5: CLI and MCP expose equivalent preflight review facts and tri-language docs describe the boundary
goal: Implement the preflight planned-scenario and human-decision receipt foundation with fail-closed identity binding and CLI/MCP parity.
intent: Add an explicit repository-bound preflight review receipt so a human may authorize a bounded implementation plan without turning planned work into verified evidence.
